fact_text: BYD launched its brand in Pakistan in August 2024, working through local partner Mega Motor Company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: BYD's first two Pakistani models, a C-segment SUV (Atto 3) and a D-segment sedan, were launched in October 2024.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: BYD began deliveries of its first two Pakistani models about three months after their October 2024 launch, in February 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: In July 2025 BYD launched the Shark 6, which it described as Pakistan's first plug-in hybrid electric pickup truck, and it drew a strong response.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: BYD's management said it priced the Atto 3 close to a locally assembled SUV to break the view that EVs are luxury goods, and the model sold well.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: In January 2026 BYD launched a fully electric B-segment SUV priced at about 7.3 million rupees and a D-segment SUV with more premium features.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: As of March 2026 BYD Pakistan had launched five models across categories, covering battery electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: BYD Pakistan's first models were imported as completely built units (CBU) from China, and local assembly was planned to follow as a second step.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Mega Motor Company, BYD's local partner, is building the Pakistan assembly plant with BYD's guidance, and BYD itself is not building the plant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The assembly plant is being set up just outside Karachi at Gharo, with planned annual output of 25,000 vehicles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Plant construction at Gharo began at the start of 2025, with about 50 million US dollars of investment going into the plant itself.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Management said the Gharo plant was on schedule and expected production to start between the third and fourth quarters of 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Initial local assembly at Gharo will use imported CKD kits, with a localisation plan to make more parts in Pakistan later.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The company plans a mix of locally assembled models and some models that will stay CBU imports, chosen by customer needs and price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The Atto 3 launched at 9 million rupees and its list price had not changed in the 16 months after launch, per the company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The fully imported 9 million rupee Atto 3 was cheaper than some locally assembled and localised cars on sale at the time, which the company said kept its price competitive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: BYD's management said it absorbs freight-cost and foreign-exchange swings itself rather than passing them to customers, which can later push prices up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Management said local production would bring a price drop, and any government incentive cuts on local production would be passed on to customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Government duty and tax incentives on CKD kits are lower for locally assembled electric vehicles, which lowers the cost of local assembly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The NEV policy's incentives also cover fully built imports, to build an early local market while assembly plants are set up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The automobile policy (captioned as 'F 2026') is set to sunset in June 2026, and a new version is expected from July 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The NEV policy was introduced by the government in 2025 as a five-year framework, and it has a sales-tax regime for CBU and CKD electric vehicles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: An interviewee said policy longevity and consistency matter most to investors deciding on EV plants, so incentives should continue beyond the sunset dates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The company argued for technology-neutral NEV policy covering both plug-in hybrids and battery electric vehicles, so that customers choose.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The company said that allowing used-car imports adds pressure on foreign reserves, and that older imports work against the emissions targets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The NEV policy introduced subsidies for two- and three-wheeler electric vehicles, and the company said four-wheeler buyers need similar support.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The company proposed green financing for electric cars, with SBP backstopping commercial banks so that EV loans carry attractive rates, as was done for rooftop solar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan caps auto financing at 3 million rupees (30 lakh), and the company said the cap keeps entry-level EVs out of reach for many buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: About 200,000 locally assembled cars were sold in calendar year 2025, a small number relative to the market's potential.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The reporter's interviewee said auto financing was a large part of the 2021-2022 car sales boom, so rate cuts and cheap loans drive volume.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Pakistan has a population of more than 240 million, and the company said its car ownership per person is among the lowest in the region.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Pakistan already has an auto-parts manufacturing supply chain, which the company said made local assembly attractive to BYD.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The 2025 EV charging policy offers discounted rates to charging operators and faster NOC and licensing, and the government plans chargers on motorways.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: A sister concern of Mega Motor Company was mandated to build EV charging infrastructure, and about 20 to 25 charging stations were installed with oil marketers such as PSO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The company plans a charging station every 200 to 250 km so that its charging network runs from Karachi to Peshawar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: BYD's vehicles are compatible with the CCS2 charging standard, so they can charge at other operators' chargers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Mega Motor Company runs company-operated BYD dealerships, experience centres and care centres in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, to support after-sales service.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Mega Motor Company has five BYD facilities in Karachi and opened a facility in Faisalabad in January 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Management aims to have 16 BYD facilities in total in Pakistan by the end of 2026, expanding into tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Mega Motor Company sent its staff to China and Thailand for certifications and uses a train-the-trainer model to build local service staff.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: Thailand tied CBU import incentives to a commitment to build a CKD plant within two to three years, with penalties if the plant is not built.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)

fact_text: The NEV policy has an emissions-reduction target, and the company said adopting EVs supports that target.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'BYD's Pakistan Plans: 25,000 Cars a Year from Gharo Facility | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-26)
